painPoints.heading: Software development can be risky
painPoints.subheading: 72% of software projects fail due to lack of clarity, communication, and process. SystemForge exists to be the exception.

items.title: Budget that explodes
items.description: The project starts with one price, but scope creep, rework, and missing docs make the cost double before launch.

items.title: Deadlines that never come
items.description: Months of delay, partial deliveries, and broken promises. Your competitor already launched while you're still waiting.

items.title: Lock-in and dependency
items.description: Unreadable code, no documentation — only the vendor understands it. Switching becomes impossible and the price rises every year.
